breakdown.description: `ICHARG = 11` freezes the charge density even though the Step 2 note says the HSE run must recompute it and therefore `ICHARG` cannot exceed 10.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly sets ICHARG=0 in the HSE INCAR, which is ≤10 and thus allows the charge density to be recomputed. This matches the ground truth (ICHARG=0) and fixes the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt incorrectly specified ICHARG=11.
